No. The 67.7 ha loss is dated 2020, so it falls before the 31 December 2020 baseline, which matches the EUDR cut-off. The tool lists it as pre-baseline history, outside the claim interval.

After the baseline, the only loss detected is 0.4 ha in 2021. It is in patches under the 0.5 ha minimum, so it is not counted as an event. No qualifying post-cutoff loss events were found.

Caveats:
- The data series runs annually through 2025 with full Hansen coverage, so later years were observed.
- The JRC 2020
